objective: Close current report freshness, source governance, targeted revalidation, and seasoning pilot gaps without broad business regression or fabricated requirements.

reasons: Governance and report defects can be proven with isolated contract tests.
Source recovery can remain limited to cases with complete executable definitions and current standard receipts.
Revalidation must be selected by current fingerprints and receipts instead of rerunning all candidates.
A single reversible seasoning pilot is sufficient to close the current same-application cross-domain gap.

scope: Bind generated results to the exact current plan fingerprint and selection fingerprint.
Reject stale results before exposing summary counts.
Keep sourceStatus, applicabilityStatus and execution action independent while deriving currentGoalBlocking correctly.
Rebuild the source-governed result from the current plan without rerunning business cases.
acceptance: No current-goal blocked-source count drift remains.

scope: Resolve six seasoning source-blocked cases through complete binding plus current standard receipt where possible.
Close TC-GRP-ADD-010 and TC-GRP-ADD-011 as current-version not-applicable without reviving deprecated semantics.
Do not send technical binding, evidence, environment or cleanup gaps to humans.
acceptance: blockedSource is zero or every remaining item is a confirmed business conflict.
Recovered rules use reconstructed-current-baseline and originalRequirementRecovered=false.
Every mutation receipt proves API/UI zero residue.

batches.purpose: 只刷新历史 40 条影响集的当前证据，不扩大为商品中心或组模块全量回归。
batches.expectedResult: 38 条可执行用例获得当前指纹终态，2 条已废弃语义保持正式不适用，选择集守恒。
batches.downstreamImpact: 仅 38 条当前收据被刷新；其余 80 条组用例、其他模块以及既有通过用例保持不变且不失效。
scope: Reconcile the historical 40-case impact set with the current 122 revalidation candidates.
Classify each case as reuse, targeted-revalidation, bounded sentinel, or excluded.
Create and validate one public execution intent before authentication, data creation or browser startup.
Persist intent/selection fingerprints plus terminal and incomplete sets after every execution unit.
Ignore out-of-scope generated drafts and non-selected module static gaps without weakening their own execution gate.
acceptance: No full-regression parameters or unrelated modules are mixed into the repair run.
Every selected case has a current terminal receipt and failures do not stop independent cases.
API/UI cleanup residue is zero for every mutation identity.
postCheck: Reconcile execution intent, checkpoint, source-governed report manifest and execution index.
Classify product failures separately from automation/evidence/environment gaps.
Automatically repair non-business gaps before B4.

batches.expectedResult: 单条 pilot 完成 create/read/update/read/delete/absence，并生成标准 evidence ledger。
batches.downstreamImpact: 只创建带 AUTO_AUDIT 身份的临时调味数据并在 finally 清理；不使其他已通过用例失效。
scope: Run one minimal authenticated reversible seasoning CRUD lifecycle.
Generate a standard evidence ledger with operation, assertion and cleanup receipts.
postCheck: Verify operation receipts are exactly bound to create/read/update/read/delete/absence.
Verify original and edited identities have API/UI zero residue.
Automatically repair technical, adapter, environment, evidence or report gaps before final acceptance.

batches.expectedResult: 商品中心项目结论与平台跨系统结论分离，所有当前证据可追溯且遗漏清单收敛。

acceptance: Project execution, source, binding, evidence, cleanup and index gates reconcile.
npm run verify:system-test-platform is executed as the final public gate.
